outcome: Gestational age at delivery (<37 weeks, <32 weeks)
cohort: The study included singleton deliveries in California from 2005 to 2008, comparing 142 women with prenatally diagnosed T13 to 2,028,862 unaffected pregnancies.
finding: Pregnancies complicated by Trisomy 13 were significantly more likely to be affected by gestational hypertensive disorders (6.3-times) and severe preeclampsia (12.5-times), and to result in delivery before 32 weeks.
gest_age: The study included all gestational ages at delivery, with specific outcomes related to delivery <37 weeks and <32 weeks.
